title: Nitrogen fertilisers
content: Nitrogen fertilisers are compounds that contain or produce nitrate or ammonium ions in the soil.

title: Laughing gas
content: Laughing gas is a chemical compound with the formula N2O, which is used as an anaesthetic.

title: Haber process
content: Haber process is an industrial process of directly synthesising ammonia from hydrogen and nitrogen.

title: Aqua regia
content: Aqua regia is a mixture of concentrated hydrochloric acid and nitric acid in a volume ratio of 3:1.

title: Rhombic sulphur
content: Rhombic sulphur is an octahedral-shaped crystalline allotropic form of sulphur. It is the most stable form of sulphur.

title: Monoclinic sulphur
content: Monoclinic sulphur is a needle-shaped crystalline allotrope of sulphur and is obtained by heating rhombic sulphur to 96 °C (369 K).

title: The Frasch Process
content: The Frasch Process is an industrial method to extract sulphur from underground elemental deposits.

title: Oxoacid
content: An oxoacid is an acid that contains hydrogen, oxygen and at least one other element.
